components.name: Primary Pill Button
components.description: Ergonomic pill button with vertical slate gradient and top-edge tactile bevel highlight.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #30354e 0%, #1e2033 100%); color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 24px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25), 0 2px 6px rgba(30, 32, 51, 0.15); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a3f5c 0%, #25283f 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35), 0 4px 12px rgba(30, 32, 51, 0.2); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 0 0 4px #1e2033; }

components.name: Secondary Pill Button
components.description: White pill button with subtle hairline border and gentle hover tint.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: #1e2033; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid rgba(30, 32, 51, 0.12); border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(30, 32, 51, 0.03); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f8f9fc; border-color: rgba(30, 32, 51, 0.2); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 0 0 4px #1e2033; }

components.name: Tactile Card

components.html:
PATTERN 04O(N log N)

Monotonic Deque & Sliding Window

components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(30, 32, 51, 0.08); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(30, 32, 51, 0.02), 0 4px 16px -2px rgba(30, 32, 51, 0.04); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(30, 32, 51, 0.14); box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(30, 32, 51, 0.04), 0 8px 24px -4px rgba(30, 32, 51, 0.07); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card-tag { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #646e82; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 8px 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #1e2033; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card-desc { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; color: #646e82; }

components.name: Pill Search Input

components.css: .ds-input-wrapper { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; max-width: 480px; } .ds-input-icon { position: absolute; left: 16px; color: #94a3b8; pointer-events: none; } .ds-input-field { width: 100%; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e6ed; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 18px 10px 42px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #1e2033; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(30, 32, 51, 0.02); outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input-field::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; } .ds-input-field:focus { border-color: #1e2033; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #1e2033; }

narrative.overview:
OpenLeet is an algorithmic pattern intelligence environment designed for engineers who value disciplined cognition over mindless code completion. Inspired by the calm clarity and tactile modernism of Sarvam AI, the interface rejects the dark-mode claustrophobia and hyperactive glowing neon tropes of generic AI tools. Instead, it provides a bright, light-first sanctuary built on soft pearl surfaces, geometric rigor, and deliberate breathing room.

The aesthetic balance pairs surgical minimalism with tangible physical depth. Elements do not float as weightless flat layers; they possess delicate 3D substance through soft, diffused ambient drop shadows, crisp 1px hairline borders, and subtle top-edge button bevels. Every pixel serves cognitive focus: problem statements, constraint trees, and algorithmic archetypes take center stage, while navigation and utility controls recede quietly until needed.

The visual system treats algorithmic mastery as an architectural discipline. Monospace type is anchored specifically to computational truths—complexity bounds, memory constraints, and code tokens—while the human layer uses Plus Jakarta Sans for warm, readable narrative guidance. Socratic hints unfold in controlled steps rather than overwhelming walls of text, reflecting our pedagogical commitment to building mental models before implementation.
keyCharacteristics: Light Architectural Canvas: Crisp pearl-white foundation (#fcfcfd) with pristine white container islands (#ffffff).
Tactile 3D Substance: Subtle multi-layer ambient drop shadows and bevel insets that give interactive elements physical weight.
Cognitive Quietude: Zero gradient clutter, zero fluorescent AI glows, and zero cartoonish illustrations.
Architectural Typography: Humanist geometric sans-serif for reading paired with precision monospace for algorithmic constraints.
Pill & Vault Geometries: Smooth fully-rounded pill actions contrasted against continuous 16px radius cards.

rules.name: The 90/10 Restraint Rule
rules.body: 90% of every screen must consist of pure slate, pearl canvas, and crisp white surfaces. Accent colors (emerald, amber, rose) may occupy no more than 10% of visual space, reserved strictly for semantic problem attributes.

rules.name: The No-Rainbow Rule
rules.body: Gradients with multiple hue shifts or neon holographic glows are strictly prohibited. Gradients are permitted only as vertical luminance shifts on solid slate or subtle ambient periwinkle backlights.

rules.name: The Mono Anchor Rule
rules.body: Any metric representing operational constraints (N <= 10^5), Big-O complexities (O(V + E)), execution limits (1000ms), or code tokens must render in JetBrains Mono. Prose and pedagogical reasoning never use monospace.

rules.name: The Ambient Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is physical and diffuse, never harsh or opaque. Drop shadows must use low-opacity slate (rgba(30, 32, 51, ...)) with large blur radii, giving surfaces a soft cushion of air above the pearl canvas.

dos: Do preserve generous whitespace around card containers (gap-6, p-6) to maintain cognitive focus.
Do anchor all computational complexity metrics (O(N), 10^8 ops) in JetBrains Mono.
Do use fully-rounded pill geometry (rounded-full) for all action buttons and status chips.
Do use the 90/10 rule: 90% slate and white canvas, 10% semantic accents.
Do place user identity, sync status, and account settings in the bottom-left sidebar.
Do isolate in-page extension panels inside a Shadow DOM to prevent CSS leaks.
donts: Don't add rainbow gradients, animated glowing borders, or fluorescent neon accents.
Don't reveal code solutions immediately; always enforce the 4-tier Socratic hint ladder (Intuition -> State -> Invariant -> Skeleton).
Don't use generic chatbot AI icons (sparkles, robot heads, or magic wands) anywhere in the interface.
Don't use harsh solid black (#000000) for text or shadows; always use charcoal slate (#1e2033 / rgba(30, 32, 51, ...)).
Don't clutter card surfaces with redundant metadata; keep titles short and punchy.
